full_suite.environment: Disposable acceptance copy with normal loopback and event-log permissions.

remediation_history: Corrected JavaScript whitespace scanning at end of input to avoid an EOF loop.
Made no-argument runner invocation execute the corpus, retained explicit --self, and made unknown arguments fail closed.
Corrected the lone-surrogate raw fixture so it exercises one JSON Unicode escape.
Added scalar-aware Python UTF-8 length measurement and mandatory M52 for paired-surrogate effect keys.
Changed JavaScript parser objects to null-prototype objects and added M53/M54 for root and declaration __proto__ members.
Canonicalized valid Python surrogate pairs before duplicate-key comparison and added M55 for escaped/literal scalar equivalence.
Restricted Python JSON numeric scanning to ASCII digits and added M56 for a non-ASCII digit after an ASCII prefix.
Replaced the fuzz oracle prototype-bearing objects with nested Maps and generated inherited-property-shaped valid effect keys.
Pinned frozen corpus profile, mandatory membership, count, uniqueness, and case-ID digest in the differential harness.
Made JavaScript and Python runner Base64url decoding reject malformed transport input consistently.
Made every recognized runner mode reject trailing arguments instead of silently ignoring them.
known_residue: Ignored python/__pycache__ generated by Python execution; excluded from manifest and commit.
An initial sandboxed full-suite run produced permission-only localhost/event-log failures and is not cited as product evidence.
